result.decision: Fill the builder view with the canvas and open stage details in a Nessa UI drawer.
result.rationale: Explicit user clarification supersedes the permanently visible inspector. learning:LN-c2ee10d1-c4da-4f84-880f-e6f59b7084f0. Workflow settings and save preview also use drawers to keep the canvas full-view. Linear ordering and validation are unchanged.

discovery.observation: User requires full-view canvas with click-to-open detail drawers, rather than inline stage settings.
discovery.regression: Open a stage drawer, edit, close, and verify canvas stays full-view on narrow screens.
